## ASR_Ohm_ESC

`model OpenTEMPEST.SOC.Electrochem.ASR.ASR_Ohm_ESC`

*Ohmic ASR of an electrolyte supported cell (ESC)*

Ohmic ASR as a function of the PEN temperature. Parameters from [doi:10.1016/j.ijhydene.2018.12.168](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijhydene.2018.12.168).
